## Seeded runs

The four primary chronologies and the ²¹⁰Pb sensitivity are refitted with
`Rscript R/run_all.R --age-models`; every run is seeded and recorded in a manifest that the test
`R/tests/test_bacon_provenance.R` checks against the stored files.

```{r}
read_output('bacon_run_manifest.csv') |>
  transmute(Model = model, Role = role, Seed = seed, rbacon = rbacon_version,
    `Control file` = control_file, `Posterior file` = posterior_file, Generated = generated_at_utc) |>
  show_table('bacon_runs', caption = '**Bacon runs behind the chronologies.**')
```
